nav.label: Account settings
nav.title: My account
nav.subtitle: Your own profile, sign-in and settings. They follow you to every AfroTransact app you use.
common.loadError: We couldn't load this. Check your connection and try again.
common.genericError: That didn't work. Please try again.
security.title: Sign-in & security
security.lead: Keep your account safe: a strong password, a second step when you sign in, and a look at where you're signed in.
password.title: Password
password.sub: Use 12 or more characters. Avoid passwords you use on other sites.
password.changed: Password changed. Other devices stay signed in until you sign them out below.
mfa.title: Two-step verification
mfa.lead: After your password, we ask for a code from your phone, so a stolen password alone can't open your account.
mfa.staffNote: Two-step verification is required for staff accounts. You can switch between methods, but one always stays on.
mfa.staffFallback: Until you set one up, we text a code to the mobile number on your account.
mfa.staffNoteSingle: To switch methods, set up the other one first. Then you can turn this one off.
mfa.appSub: Google Authenticator, Microsoft Authenticator, 1Password, Authy or any app that supports time-based codes
mfa.smsSub: We text a 6-digit code to your mobile number
mfa.recoveryLeft: {n, plural, one {# unused code left} other {# unused codes left}} · each works once if you lose your phone
mfa.recoveryNone: You'll get recovery codes when you turn on a method
mfa.offConfirmBody: Signing in will only need your password until you turn a method on again.
mfa.offConfirmSwitch: You'll sign in with your other method from now on.
mfa.lockedHint: Required: set up another method before turning this off
totp.title: Set up your authenticator app
totp.step1: Open your authenticator app and add an account.
totp.step2: Scan this QR code with your phone's camera.
totp.step3: Enter the 6-digit code the app shows.
totp.qrLabel: QR code to add AfroTransact to your authenticator app
totp.manual: Enter this setup key in your app instead (time-based, 6 digits, every 30 seconds):
totp.codeHelp: The code changes every 30 seconds. Enter the one on screen now.
totp.codeInvalid: Enter the 6 digits from your app
sms.title: Turn on text message codes
sms.noPhone: Add a mobile number to your profile first, then come back to turn on text message codes.
sms.intro: We'll text a 6-digit code to {phone}. Message and data rates may apply.
sms.sent: We sent a code to {phone}. It expires in 10 minutes.
codes.title: Save your recovery codes
codes.lead: If you lose your phone, each of these codes signs you in once. We'll only show them now: store them somewhere safe, like a password manager.
codes.newBody: Your current codes stop working right away.
codes.fileHeader: AfroTransact recovery codes for {email}. Each code works once.
passkeys.title: Passkeys
passkeys.lead: Sign in with Face ID, Touch ID, Windows Hello or a security key. Passkeys can't be phished and need no code.
passkeys.addHint: Adding a passkey opens a secure AfroTransact page in a new tab. Come back here when you're done.
passkeys.removeBody: You won't be able to sign in with this passkey any more.
trusted.title: Trusted browsers
trusted.lead: Browsers where you chose “Trust this browser” skip the second step for 30 days.
trusted.forgotten: Browser forgotten. It will ask for the second step next time.
sessions.title: Where you're signed in
sessions.lead: Every AfroTransact app and browser signed in to your account.
sessions.othersDone: {n, plural, one {Signed out # other session} other {Signed out # other sessions}}
activity.title: Recent sign-in activity
activity.lead: If something here wasn't you, change your password and sign out everywhere else.
linked.title: Linked sign-in accounts
linked.none: No Google, Apple or Facebook account is linked.
profile.title: Profile
profile.lead: How you appear to your team and to AfroTransact.
profile.emailManaged: Managed by AfroTransact IT. Ask IT to change it.
profile.emailFixed: Your sign-in email can't be changed here. Contact support to move your account to another address.
profile.phoneHelp: Used for text message codes and urgent alerts.
profile.jobTitleHelp: Shown to your team, e.g. “Store manager”.
profile.avatar: Your initials appear in the header and on activity.
orgs.title: Organisations & roles
orgs.lead: Stores and businesses you belong to. Owners and admins change roles in Team & roles.
orgs.none: You don't belong to an organisation yet.
orgs.ownerNote: Owners can't leave. Make someone else an owner first.
orgs.leaveBody: You'll lose access to {name} straight away. An owner can invite you again.
roles.title: Roles & access
roles.lead: Your staff roles decide what you can open in the console. A Super Admin grants roles in Access control.
notify.title: Notifications
notify.lead: Choose which alerts reach you and how. Security codes and sign-in alerts always reach you.
notify.alertsLead: Pick a channel for each kind of alert.
notify.alwaysHint: Required so you never miss it
notify.quietLead: Hold texts during these hours (your time zone). Email still arrives, and security codes always send.
notify.topic.seller.orders.sub: New orders, cancellations and shipping deadlines
notify.topic.seller.inventory.sub: Listings about to sell out or out of stock
notify.topic.seller.compliance.sub: Verification requests, listing decisions and account health
notify.topic.seller.claims.sub: Customer claims that need your response
notify.topic.staff.assigned.sub: Cases, applications and tasks routed to you
notify.topic.staff.escalations.sub: Escalated cases and SLA breaches in your queues
notify.topic.staff.approvals.sub: Refunds, payouts and changes that need your sign-off
contact.title: How we contact you
contact.lead: Order updates, delivery alerts and receipts.
contact.pushSub: On phones with the AfroTransact app
marketing.title: Offers & news
marketing.lead: Deals, new arrivals from your communities and AfroTransact news.
marketing.consent: You can stop any time. We never sell your data.
prefs.title: Preferences
prefs.lead: How dates, numbers and tables look to you.
prefs.languageHelp: Pages and messages from AfroTransact use this language.
prefs.timeZoneHelp: Dates and times, and quiet hours for alerts.
prefs.densityHelp: The default for every table. You can still change a table from its Columns menu.
